conclusion: No transmitted digital metadata loss or reviewed main-action caption omission found; sender motion sampling and budget fallback demonstrably omit parts of the available detailed motion evidence.

scope.source_role: diagnostic only; no original used to change reconstruction

findings.detail: 108 base metadata packets byte-identical; caption/flow CSV and actual decoder input CSV match; 83 transmitted trajectory packets byte-identical. This does not imply analog visual reconstruction is lossless.

findings.scope: 199 unique segment captions at 10dB; text/key selections also matched across SNR
findings.detail: Caption word sequence preserved in effective T5 prompts; prompt hashes match decoder calls; all prompt token counts below 300.

findings.scope: Five selected videos and source-paired frames
findings.detail: Train movement, bending/rising, repeated leg extension, grain motion, and flowing/rippling water are explicitly present. This is not an exhaustive semantic audit of all 36 videos.

Only source clip offsets 0/10/20/30 (clamped for short clips) feed the single global motion scalar; later source frames do not contribute. Other transmitted modalities may still contain related information.

findings.scope: 85 of 199 unique segments; 121 of 597 flow pairs
findings.detail: Short clips repeat their last frame. These comparisons contain no real temporal change; the size and quality effect of any numerical bias were not measured.
24 missing packets at 6/8dB plus one at 10dB. The sender intentionally fell back because no trajectory packet fit its declared budget; not packet loss in transit. Captions and keyframes still exist.

findings.scope: 12 of 36 videos have only endpoint keys; maximum key gap 30 seconds
findings.detail: Intermediate full RGB frames are not transmitted as keys. This alone does not prove an important event was absent from all other modalities.

limitations: Original/generated videos and key/track overlays reviewed on five selected failure windows, not exhaustive independent ground truth.
Scalar-flow temporal coverage excludes later frames, but caption/trajectory/key modalities can carry complementary information.
No counterfactual sender-enrichment generation experiment; contribution to reconstruction error is not causally quantified.
